title: PushSubscription/get args
description: Arguments for PushSubscription/get (RFC 8620 §7.2 / §5.1). Account-less: the subscriptions belong to the calling credential. Naming url or keys in properties is forbidden.

ids.description: PushSubscription ids to fetch. If null, returns every subscription of the calling credential.

properties.description: PushSubscription properties to return. Null returns every property except url and keys.
